tooltipEstTax:
Calculated from the gain portion of funds remitted to Thailand × FX rate on remittance date
Only the gain portion is taxable per Revenue Code
tooltipRemitted:
Every remittance dated in this tax year, including one against an earlier year's sale
Used to calculate tax per remittance rules
tooltipNetGain:
Realised gain on every sale dated in this tax year, whether or not the money came back
Each amount is the sale's full figure, not prorated to what was remitted
The tax figure is computed from remittances, so these cards do not add up to it
tooltipNotRemitted:
Sale proceeds from this tax year that have not been returned to Thailand yet
Not a cash balance — the proceeds may have been reinvested offshore
Taxed in the year the money is remitted
